data.description: You’ve heard the buzz: SillyTavern is one of the most flexible front-ends for roleplay and chat with large language models. But where do you start, which models should you use, and how do you unlock its best features without breaking something? This guide walks you through, step by step—no fluff, just a practical, solution‑oriented path from installation to pro-level sessions.
